## Nudgebee Change Gate

### Review
* **fraud-detection**: Memory limits and requests were increased to 512Mi. The sizing check was inconclusive as no recent recommendation data was found. Configuration and environment variables were also changed. A past [incident 2026-08-07](https://dev.nudgebee.pollux.in/investigate?id=45c8eb3b-cc83-4595-910b-21c40356dfdc&accountId=a2a30b02-0f67-42e5-a2ab-c658230fd798) was caused by the default finite gRPC call deadline expiring on 'EventStream'. Verify that the new 'streamDeadlineMs(0)' setting prevents these timeouts.

reviews.body:
## Code Review

This pull request increases the memory requests and limits for the `fraud-detection` component to `512Mi` in the Kubernetes values configuration to prevent OOMKills. The review feedback recommends also increasing the JVM max heap size (e.g., to `-Xmx350m`) via `envOverrides` to prevent underutilizing the allocated container memory and to avoid frequent garbage collection pauses.
